claim: Plan the independent Refine benchmark as a theory DAG with fixed-target allocation, evidence-backed contract relations, legal parent-premise reuse and coarse auxiliary intents; local proof DAGs belong to File Planner.

model.role: Propose theory grouping, justified theory predecessors and explicit ready-theory priority.

allowed_planner_inputs: compact cards for every verified Refine contract
exact contract records returned by bounded inspect_contracts requests
verified strict-parent premise records returned by bounded search and inspection
Refine session/import summaries, legal context profiles and deterministic relation candidates
forbidden_planner_inputs: raw human Refine proof bodies or unrestricted repository reads
deleted human helper names, statements, proof order or proof graph
CRefine data or results from another experiment
environment IDs, private preparation inventories, recovery journals and checkpoints

rules.fixed_contracts: Every fixed contract occurs exactly once. Copy frozen statements/context/attributes; never accept model replacements.
rules.theory_grouping: Generated theory grouping is chosen by the planner. Auxiliary-only theories are allowed. Original owners are not output constraints.
rules.premises: Reuse only inspected IDs from the immutable Refine parent-premise database; no pending contract or auxiliary is usable as a premise.
rules.failure: The later proof stage retains failed auxiliaries and their evidence, then stops that theory; fixed contracts and GREEN nodes remain immutable.
rules.validation: Exact contract coverage, theory DAG, legal premise IDs and nonempty rationale; rationale truth/adequacy is not mechanically certified.
rules.context_budget: Begin with compact contract cards, inspect exact contracts in bounded batches, and retrieve parent premises on demand with hard limits; preserve exact statements without truncation.
rules.auxiliary_intents: Optional shared-result intentions; precise statements and local dependencies belong to File Planner.
rules.theory_dependencies: Explicit revisable predecessor theories with reasons; no mandatory proof references or helper commitments.
rules.priority: Theory array order is the explicit tie-break among ready theories; predecessor edges take precedence.
